content.text: •USPSTF recommends screening for HBV infect in adolescents & adults @ ↑ risk for infect
•USPSTF recommends screening for HBV infect in preg women @ their 1st prenatal visit
•USPSTF recommends screening for LTBI in pop @ ↑ risk
postmenopausal women <65yo @ ↑ risk for an osteoporotic frx as est by clin risk assessment
: age, ↓BMI, ETOH, smoker, long-term steroid use, prev factures, hx of falls in past yr
•USPSTF recommends exercise interventions to prevent falls in community-dwelling adults ≥65yo @ ↑ risk for falls
•USPSTF recommends screening for prediabetes & T2DM in
; optimal screening freq undefined, some studies suggest screening q3y may be reasonable
•Offer/refer pts w/ prediabetes → effective preventive interventions
•USPSTF recommends screening for GDM in aSx preg persons @ ≥24wk gestation
Wt Loss to Prevent Obesity-Related Morbidity & Mortality
•USPSTF recommends offering/referring adults w/ BMI ≥30 to intensive, multicomponent behavioral interventions
•USPSTF recommends providing/referring children & adolescents ≥6yo w/ ↑BMI (≥95th percentile for age & sex) to comprehensive, intensive behavioral interventions
Healthy wt & wt Gain in preg
•USPSTF recommends offering preg persons effective behavioral counseling interventions to promote healthy wt gain & prevent excess gestational wt gain
•USPSTF recommends screening for aSx bacteriuria in preg persons
•USPSTF strongly recommends Rh(D) blood typing & Ab testing for all preg women @ their 1st visit for pregnancy-related care (A)
•USPSTF recommends repeat Rh(D) Ab testing for all unsensitized Rh(D)(-) women @ 24-28wk gestation, unless biological father known to be Rh(D)(-) (B)
Folic Acid to Prevent Neural Tube Defects
Persons who plan to or could become preg
•USPSTF recommends a daily supp w/ 0.4-0.8mg (400-800mcg) folic acid for all persons planning to or who could become preg
•USPSTF recommends interventions or Refer, during preg & after birth, to support breastfeed
•USPSTF recommends applying fluoride varnish to the primary teeth of all infants & children starting @ primary tooth eruption
•USPSTF recommends PO fluoride supp starting @6mo for children whose H2O supply = deficient in fluoride
•USPSTF recommends vision screening ≥1x in all children 3-5yo to detect amblyopia or its RFs
